answer: Each identity must keep a living pulse: 15 distinct counterparties each epoch, or no rewards. Links enter a ferrous ledger; closed-cluster trades do not count. Self-trading rings are marked in sable, their links void. Each link burns 6 credits: 1,000 fake identities need 15,000 links, burning 90,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 50,000 loss. Borrowed names repeat a lender's partners; both are flagged. An honest agent pays 90 once and keeps a full share.
